WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category AS cat_as_is, n.cat_was, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
  AND (cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR n.cat_was IN ('Garden','Electrical'))
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

),
net_lines AS (

    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key

    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL

    FROM fact_return_line r

    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine_total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id = 900 THEN n.net_sales END) AS mine_web
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id = 900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS ctl_web
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND r.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, ROUND(mine_total,2) AS mine_total, ROUND(ctl_total,2) AS ctl_total, ROUND(mine_total-ctl_total,2) AS gap,
       ROUND(mine_web,2) AS mine_web, ROUND(ctl_web,2) AS ctl_web
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year) ORDER BY 1

SELECT ty.category, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 8 AS fiscal_period,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM period_sales ty
JOIN period_sales ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.category
